messages:
maria-sales: Hey @dom-security — DockerBay needs a SOC2 excerpt + a signed pen-test letter for the POC. Procurement says Dedicated capacity pricing is blocked until they get it. ETA?

dom-security: What exactly do they want? A letter signed by our third-party pen-test vendor or an internal attestation?

maria-sales: Quote from their buyer: "We require vendor-signed pen-test attestation confirming external scan completed in last 12 months, plus a company-signed letter stating remediation SLA for critical findings." Also asked for staging IPs and data residency confirmation.

alex-ps: We have a vendor attestation from our last pentest (redacted). We can provide that + an internal letter from Legal confirming remediation SLA and who owns remediation. For vendor-signed letter we need vendor OK to re-sign or reuse — I'll check.

olivia-engr: Heads up on staging IPs: if they want external scans against our staging we need a scan window and an ops contact. Earliest available window is Thu 18:00–22:00 UTC. Also, if they require network diagrams with VLAN/subnet details we should limit it to an excerpt.

dom-security: @sophie-legal can you confirm we can issue the remediation-SLA letter? Also I can assemble the SOC2 excerpt and the redacted vendor attestation.

sophie-legal: I can sign the internal remediation SLA letter. We should not publish full SOC2 report — provide the AICPA bridge letter or a SOC2 excerpt (control matrix). Send me the proposed wording and I'll sign.

maria-sales: Customer deadline: EOD Friday. Can we hit that? They're pressing because procurement committee meets next Monday.

alex-ps: Timeline risks: getting the vendor to re-sign could take 3–5 business days. If they accept a vendor attestation we already have (with redaction) + our internal SLA letter, that should be same-day. Also note pricing: if Dedicated reservation start is delayed past the committed date due to compliance sign-off, billing adjustments might apply per contract. I'll flag pricing to AM.

olivia-engr: For the external scan we need: contact email, desired scan window, and the IP list to whitelist. We can provide ephemeral staging IPs from the 34.120.x.x range; will hand off ASN and CIDR once window confirmed.

dom-security: Draft plan: (1) I upload redacted vendor attestation + SOC2 excerpt to the secure folder; (2) @sophie-legal drafts remediation-SLA letter and signs; (3) @maria-sales confirms whether customer will accept redacted attestation or requires vendor re-sign. If they need re-sign, we escalate to vendor.

maria-sales: I'll ask procurement now and loop back. Also: DockerBay asked whether Dedicated POC pricing can be held while these docs are reviewed.

alex-ps: We can hold quote for 72 hours once we acknowledge receipt of docs. After that standard quote expiration applies. I'll mark the deal note.

evidence-bot: reminder: upload all artifacts to /secure/proofpacks/dockerbay/<ts> and set ACL to procurement@dockerbay.com (automated at 1758880200).

dom-security: Uploaded initial artifacts and pinged vendor for re-sign. Link: https://redwood.internal/secure/proofpacks/dockerbay/1758880000 (internal-only).

maria-sales: DockerBay confirmed they'll accept redacted vendor attestation + our signed SLA. They want staging IPs by tomorrow morning and the signed letter by EOD Friday.

olivia-engr: I'll reserve the Thursday window and generate ephemeral IPs. Ops contact: ops-oncall@redwood.ai.

sophie-legal: Drafted remediation-SLA, signed, and uploaded to folder.

dom-security: All done — SOC2 excerpt, redacted vendor attestation, and signed remediation letter are in the folder. Sent to DockerBay procurement with email thread.

maria-sales: Perfect. I'll update the PO and lock pricing hold for 72 hours. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
